race.comment: SOUTHERN HEIRESS (12) dug deep last start to hold off the fast finishing Biancelli, who goes around later. Goes up in the weights but still has improvement to come and can repeat the dose. KOKATAHI (7) is one of the main threats, coming off a decisive BM65 win at Eagle Farm as favourite after a close second at this venue. CAMELIGHT (20) was okay fresh but has since gone back to the trials and looks a look sharper now with the blinkers on. Don't underestimate. LIM'S SHAVANO (4) lost his way but has been freshened with 35 days and drops back in trip. Recent trial suggests he's back on track. IKASARA (3) is in good touch but has to transfer his form on to the turf.
